# Anchored mouth poses · v2

This set replaces the generic atlas approach in the separate audio-tour workshop, not the main CV portrait. Each pose is a full transparent character source registered at its native coordinates onto the 1261 × 1247 logical anchor. The O and narrow-teeth source canvases differ slightly in size; their image dimensions and eye/nose registration offsets are recorded in the map. The renderer reads a native 105 × 60 source region into the fixed target mouth region [556, 292, 105, 60], with no patch resizing.

## Sources

`mouth-aei.png` is an unchanged copy of the earlier user-preferred `character-anchor-v2/mouth.png` gentle open-mouth frame. `mouth-fv.png` and `mouth-th.png` reuse full anchored frames from v1. Nine other source images were generated by editing the preferred open-mouth character directly, with the resting anchor as a second identity reference. All files are copied unchanged from generation; source PNG pixels are not edited by a script.

Files: `mouth-aei.png`, `mouth-o.png`, `mouth-u.png`, `mouth-cdnstxyz.png`, `mouth-gk.png`, `mouth-l.png`, `mouth-bmp.png`, `mouth-fv.png`, `mouth-ee.png`, `mouth-th.png`, `mouth-chjsh.png`, `mouth-qw.png`. Registration and pose descriptions are in `mouth-map.json`; built-in image-generation prompts and provenance are in `generation-prompts.json`.

The workshop initially selects the preferred gentle open pose. Rest selects the unmodified anchor mouth. You can preview any pose or cycle all twelve with hair and blinking. Pause stops animation and returns to rest. Selecting a pose stops playback for still inspection. Mouth-only frame tests require every pixel outside the active mouth mask to stay unchanged, including the eyes and hair.

These are draft animation poses, not a pronunciation guide or verified phonetic model. No audio synchronization, speech recognition, main-page integration, Git push or deployment is included. The v1 atlas experiment and all original portrait assets remain preserved.
